title.value: The BigScience ROOTS Corpus: A 1.6TB Composite Multilingual Dataset
title.justification: The title is directly extracted from the paper and captures the main focus, which is the creation of a large-scale multilingual dataset.
title.quote: The BigScience ROOTS Corpus: A 1.6TB Composite Multilingual Dataset

extractions.description: This paper documents the efforts of the BigScience project to assemble a composite multilingual dataset, known as the ROOTS corpus, designed to support the training of large language models, including the BigScience Large Open-science Open-access Multilingual (BLOOM) language model. The corpus spans 59 languages and prioritizes ethical, sociopolitical, and data governance issues.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is the creation and curation of a large-scale multilingual dataset for language modeling, which does not directly address Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development issues.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: As language models grow ever larger, the need for large-scale high-quality text datasets has never been more pressing, especially in multilingual settings.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily addresses issues related to multilingual datasets and language model training, which do not align with any Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories.
primary_category.quote: This paper documents the data creation and curation efforts undertaken by BigScience to assemble the Responsible Open-science Open-collaboration Text Sources (ROOTS) corpus.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not address secondary themes related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
secondary_categories.quote: The BigScience workshop, a 1-year international and multidisciplinary initiative, was formed with the goal of researching and training large language models as a values-driven undertaking, putting issues of ethics, harm, and governance in the foreground.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-categories related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development are not pertinent to this paper, as it focuses on multilingual datasets and language models.
primary_sub_category.quote: The goal of the current paper is twofold: (1) we present a preliminary gated, subject to committing to the BigScience ethical charter, release of a large subset of ROOTS; (2) we release the numerous data tools that were developed along the way and enabled us to curate, source, clean and inspect all 498 constituent datasets that come together to constitute ROOTS.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: There are no secondary sub-categories relevant to the themes of this paper within Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development contexts.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The efforts described in the previous sections come together in an assemblage of 1.6 Terabytes of multilingual text.

applications.justification: There are no specific applications related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development mentioned in the paper.
applications.quote: We have presented ROOTS, a massive multilingual corpus that was the result of an international collaboration between multidisciplinary researchers studying large language models.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper is focused on language datasets and models, which do not necessitate a new category in Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
